versions.content: The Ea module shall call the function defined in the configuration parameter EaNvMJobErrorNotification upon failure of an asynchronous read operation after performing all necessary internal management and error handling operations. Failure of an asynchronous read operation implies the read job is finished and has failed (i.e. block invalid or inconsistent).
